summary: Reinitialized the signature bucket for every word, erasing previously appended words with the same signature.
trigger: When inserting into a dictionary bucket that may already contain earlier grouped items.
corrected_rule: Initialize a bucket only when its key is absent; always append without replacing an existing bucket.
repair_prompt: For an original sequence with two items sharing a key, trace the bucket before and after inserting the second item without losing the first.
